column1: # Build-only archive for dependencies/build-apple-gpu-llvm.sh. The iOS Simulator
# GPU prefix links Mesa llvmpipe against LLVM built from this release, which
# Mesa 26.2 supports (it asks for LLVM 8 or newer on AArch64). The SHA-256 is
# the identity of the source and matches the checksum Homebrew's llvm@22
# formula records for the same URL.
